reviewer_role: W2 authored the geometry and independently inspected all eight full W1 originals; this is an author visual assessment, with W1/root providing separate review.

findings.finding: Less dark side mass behind the ears and neck; face, eyebrows and crest remain open. Useful reduction, but the top attachment is not well exposed in this angle.
Oversized crown lobe is reduced and ear/neck separation improves. Rear locks now project almost horizontally before curling down, reading as stiff blades with a very exposed nape.
Clear background gap between retained topknot/tie and reduced crown makes the knot visibly float. Nape is shorter with tapered staggered ends, but the discontinuity is decisive.
Bright sky clearly shows the gap below the knot; it reads as a detached piece during the actual cast. Face/ear/crest remain visible; no new hair/bow obstruction is evident in this frame.

prioritized_visible_issue: Retained topknot is visibly detached from reduced crown in rear and actual cast views.
one_prioritized_action: Seat the existing knot into a compact swept root bridge while retaining the reduced crown mass; verify physical-looking continuity in the same rear/profile/cast originals before reconsidering promotion.
secondary_observation: Rear locks look stiff and nearly horizontal in profile; record for the same next visual review rather than authoring another variation now.
limitations: Four matched views; no whole-hero visual quality or continuous-motion claim. Successful source/import counters do not establish visible attachment. No mesh, material, runtime, helper or canonical asset edits made during this review. Current package/checkpoint is not held.
